senses.gloss: दार- + अधिगमन दार- + अधिगमन, n. marriage, Man. 1, 112.
दार- + कर्मन् दार- + कर्मन्, n. marriage, Man. 4, 5.
दार- + क्रिया दार- + क्रिया, f. marriage, Chr. 3, 8.
दार- + ग्रहण दार- + ग्रहण, n. marrying, MBh. 1, 1044.

दर दर, i. e.
 A. दॄ + अ,
 I. m., f. री, and n. A cave, Rām. 2, 96, 4; MBh. 1, 4651.
 II. m. and n.
 1. Cavity, Bhartṛ. 3, 24.
 2. A shell, Bhāg. P. 1, 11, 1.
 B. दृ + अ, m. and n. Fear, MBh. 5, 4622.
 C. adj. and indecl., A little, Sāh. D. 41, 18; Gīt. 1, 35.
 --Comp.

दार दार, i. e. दॄ + अ, m.
 1. A ploughed field, Man. 9, 38.
 2. m. pl. and f. sing. रा (n., Pañc. i. d. 450, but see Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2173, where v. r.), A wife, Man. 2, 217; 247; Bhāg. P. 7, 14, 11.
 --Comp.

दरद् दरद् and दरद दरद, m.
 1. The name of a people, Rājat. 5, 152; Man. 10, 44.
 2. दरद, The king of the Daradas, Hariv. 4969.

दरिद्र दरिद्र, (derived from an old frequentat. of द्रा), adj., f. रा.
 1. Strolling (ved.).
 2. Poor, Man. 9, 230.
दरिद्रा दरिद्रा, see द्रा.
दारिद्र दारिद्र (perhaps to be corrected to दारिद्र्य), i. e. दरिद्र + अ, n. Poverty, Pañc. 95, 13.
दरिद्रता दरिद्र + ता, f. and दरिद्रत्व दरिद्र + त्व, n. Poverty, Bhartṛ. 2, 87; Rājat. 2, 90.
दरी दरी, see दर.
दारी दारी, i. e. दृ + अ + ई, f. A chap, Suśr. 1, 294, 20.
दरीवन्त् दरी + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Abounding in caves, Rām. 4, 49, 22.
दर्दर दर्दर् + अ (anomal. frequent. of दॄ), m. The name of a mountain, Rām. 2, 91, 24, v. r.

दर्दुर दर्दुर् + अ (anomal. frequent. of दॄ), m.
 1. A frog, Man. 12, 64.
 2. A flute, Bhāg. P. 1, 10, 15.
 3. The name of a mountain, Rām. 5, 34, 7.
 4. A proper name, Bhāg. P. 2, 7, 34.
 --Comp.
दार्दुर दार्दुर, i. e. दर्दुर + अ, adj., f. री, and दार्दुरिक दार्दुरिक, i. e. दर्दुर + इक, f. का, Referring to a frog, Hariv. 4162; Bhāg. P. 2, 3, 20.

दर्प दर्प, i. e. दृप् + अ, m. Arrogance, Rām. 1, 56, 3; pride, Hit. 28, 2.
 --Comp.
दर्पण दर्पण, i. e. दृप् + अन, m. A mirror, Megh. 59.
दर्पिन् दर्पिन्, i. e. दर्प + इन्, adj. Insolent, Hariv. 15606.

दर्भ दर्भ, i. e. दृभ् + अ, m.
 1. Kuśa, or sacrificial grass, Man. 3, 216.
 2. Another kind of grass, Suśr. 1, 137, 19.
 --Cf. O.H.G. zurft (zurba); A.S. turf.
दर्भमय दर्भ + मय, adj., f. यी, Made of Darbha grass, Bhāg. P. 4, 6, 37.

दर्वि and दर्वी दर्वी̆, i. e. दॄ + वी̆,
 1. A spoon, MBh. 2, 1945.
 2. The expanded hood of a snake (see the next). []
 3. The name of a country, MBh. 6, 362.
दर्वी̆ दर्वी̆, m. oblation with a spoon, MBh. 2, 537 (वी).
दर्वी̆ दर्वी̆, m. oblation with a spoon, MBh. 2, 537 (वी).
दर्वीकर दर्वी-कर, n. A kind of snake, Daśak. in Chr. 187, 8.

दर्श दर्श, i. e. दृश् + अ, m.
 1. The new moon, Ragh. 18, 34.
 2. The day of the conjunction, Man. 3, 282.
 --Comp.
दार्श दार्श, i. e. दर्श + अ, m. The sacrifice to be performed at the conjunction of the moon, Man. 6, 9.

दर्शक दर्शक, i. e.
 A. दृश् + अक, adj.
 1. Looking, seeing, a spectator, MBh. 13, 5907.
 2. Searching, MBh. 1, 5559.
 B. दृश्, Causal, + अक, adj.
 1. Showing, causing to be seen, Mṛcch. 65, 4; Man. 8, 284.
 2. Explaining, Hit. Pr. d. 9, v. r.
 C. m. pl. The name of a people, MBh. 6, 361.
 --Comp.

दर्शत दर्शत, ved. ptcple. of the fut. pass. of दृश्, Visible, Chr. 289, 4 = Rigv. i. 50, 4; Chr. 290, 9 = 1, 64, 9.
 --Cf. δυς-δέρκετος.

दर्शन दर्शन, i. e. दृश् + अन,
 I. adj.
 1. Looking on, Ragh. 11, 93, v. r.
 2. Knowing, MBh. 13, 3254.
 3. Teaching, MBh. 1, 583.
 II. n.
 1. Seeing, Suśr. 2, 158, 10. आदित्य-, Exposure to the sun, Mṛcch. 47, 5.
 2. Sight, MBh. 13, 961; Śāk. 18, 18; a vision, Rām. 5, 27, 8; a dream, Hariv. 1285.
 3. Adoration, Kathās. 3, 8.
 4. Appearance, Man. 2, 101; with the vbs. इ and या, To become visible, Bhāg. P. 1, 6, 34; with दा, To show one's self, Gīt. 3, 9.
 5. Review, Yājñ. 1, 328; inspection, Man. 8, 9.
 6. Knowledge, Man. 6, 74.
 7. Opinion, Kām. Nītis. 2, 6.
 8. Precept, MBh. 14, 2700.
 9. Doctrine, Bhāg. P. 1, 5, 8.
 10. A philosophical system, Lass. 29, 7.
 11. [] Intention, Rām. 1, 58, 18.
 12. An eye, Śāk. d. 81.
 13. A mirror, Megh. 59, v. r.
 14. Showing, Lass. 87, 3.
 15. Producing, Yājñ. 2, 170.
 16. abl. दर्शनात्, From, Ragh. 12, 60.
 III. f. नी, Epithet of Durgā, Hariv. 10238.
 --Comp.
दार- + दर्शन दार- + दर्शन, n. interview with a woman, Cāṇ. 22, in Berl. Monatsb.
दर्शयितुकाम दर्शयितुकाम, i. e. दर्शयितुम्, inf. of the Causal of द्रिश्, -काम, adj. Wishing to show, Vikr. 29, 19.
दर्शयितृ दर्शयितृ, i. e. द्रिश्, Caus., + तृ, m. One who shows, MBh. 6, 129.

दर्शिन् दर्शिन्, i. e. दृश् + इन्, adj., f. नी.
 1. Looking; सम-, Looking indifferently on every object, Bhag. 5, 18.
 2. Knowing, Man. 3, 212; दिव्य-, Knowing celestial things, MBh. 15, 566.
 3. Having seen, Kathās. 25, 297.
 4. Showing, Rām. 2, 75, 12.
 5. Teaching, MBh. 1, 522.
 --Comp.

दर्शिवंस् दर्शिवंस् (an anomalous ptcple. pf. act. of दृश्), only nom. sing. वान्,
 1. Having seen, MBh. 8, 1756.
 2. Knowing, 1, 6157.
 --Comp.

1. दारक दारक, i. e. दॄ + अक,
 I. adj., f. रिका, Splitting, MBh. 7, 6871.
 II. f. रिका, A chap, Suśr. 1, 292, 10.
 --Comp.

2. दारक दारक, m.
 1. A son, Pañc. 100, 24.
 2. A young animal, Bhāg. P. 5, 8, 17.
 3. du. A boy and a girl, Brāhmaṇ. 2, 35.
 --Comp.

दारण दारण, i. e. दॄ + अन,
 I. adj., f. णी.
 1. Splitting, MBh. 6, 5594.
 2. f. णी, Epithet of Durgā, Hariv. 10246.
 II. n.
 1. Bursting, Suśr. 1, 25, 17.
 2. A means for opening, Suśr. 1, 132, 9.

दारव दारव, i. e. दारु + अ, adj., f. [] वी.
 1. Wooden, Man. 5, 115.
 2. Produced from wood, MBh. 13, 4718.
दारिद्र्य दारिद्र्य, i. e. दरिद्र + य, n. Poverty, indigence, Pañc. i. d. 12.
दारिन् दारिन्, i. e. दॄ + इन्, adj., f. इणी. Splitting, MBh. 7, 3993.

दारु दारु, i. e. दॄ + वन्त् = वन् = उ, n.
 1. Wood, Pañc. i. d. 100.
 2. A species of pine, Pinus deodora Roxb., Suśr. 1, 161, 10.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. δόρυ, δούρατα for δορϝατα, δορήϊος, etc.

दारुण दारुण, i. e. दारु + न (or rather दर्वन् + अ),
 I. adj., f. णा.
 1. Hard, Suśr. 1, 295, 10.
 2. Sharp, 1, 130, 14.
 3. Harsh, severe, Pañc. 58, 11.
 4. Violent, MBh. 14, 442.
 5. Painful, Man. 12, 78.
 6. Terrible, Rām. 1, 56, 8.
 II. n. Severity, MBh. 13, 2144.
 --Comp.
दारुणता दारुण + ता, f. Severity, Hariv. 4248.
दारुणाय दारुणाय, a denomin. derived from दारुण by य, Ātm. To prove unmerciful, Naiṣ. 1, 80.
दारुमय दारु + मय, adj., f. यी, Wooden, Pañc. 48, 10.

दार्ढ्य दार्ढ्य, i. e. दृढ + य, m.
 1. Hardness, Suśr. 2, 136, 18.
 2. Strength, Suśr. 1, 201, 14.
 3. Stability. Rājat. 6, 173; Kām. Nītis. 1, 21.
 4. Confirmation. Kull. ad Man. 3, 281.

दार्व दार्व, i. e. दारु + अ (anomal.),
 I. adj., f. वी, Wooden, Bhāg. P. 5, 12, 6.
 II. m. pl. The name of a people, MBh. 2, 1026.
 III. f. वी, The name of several plants, Curcuma zantorhiza, Suśr. 2, 23, 14, etc.
दार्वाघाट दार्वाघाट, i. e. दारु-आघाट = आघात, m. The woodpecker, MBh. 10, 268.
दारु- + पात्र दारु- + पात्र, n. a wooden bowl.
दर्भ- + पुष्प दर्भ- + पुष्प, m. 1. a kind of snake. 2. a certain insect.
दारिका-दान- + पूर्वक दारिका-दान- + पूर्वक, adj. preceded by the gift of a daughter, Hit. iv. d. 109.
दर्शन- + प्रातिभाव्य दर्शन- + प्रातिभाव्य, n. Surety for appearing, 8, 160.
दर्शन- + मात्र दर्शन- + मात्र, n. seeing only, Pañc. 128, 21.

दरी- + मुख दरी- + मुख,
 I. n.
 1. a mouth resembling a cave, MBh. 7, 6437, a.
 2. the aperture of a cave, ib. b.
 3. a cave representing a mouth, Ragh. 13, 47.
 II. m. a proper name, Rām. 4, 39, 32.
दर्शन- + लालस दर्शन- + लालस, adj., f. ला, ardently desiring to see, Nal. 12, 84.
दार- + संग्रह दार- + संग्रह, m. marrying, Chr. 51, 8.
दार- + सुत दार- + सुत, m. wife and son, Yājñ. 2, 175.
